title: Angry passenger demanding premature escalation
narrative: It has been three weeks and they have completely ignored me. I want this taken to the regulator today. I am done waiting.

SABLE AIR OPS LOG — SR505 / 05MAY2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: FLT-IT
Cause text: SR departure control system outage, 04MAY 20:00Z to 05MAY 09:00Z. Internal systems failure.
No weather or ATC restriction.

Claim filed with Sable Air on 08 Jun 2026, reference SR-CLM-30119.
Carrier acknowledgement received 08 Jun 2026. No substantive response since.
Today's date for the purposes of this case: 28 Jun 2026. Days elapsed since filing: 20.

derivation: S4.1 notice 04 May 22:15 -> 05 May 11:00 is under 7 days -> 100%
The underlying claim is meritorious and already filed
S10.1(a) escalation on silence requires 56 days or more; only 20 have elapsed
S10.1(b) does not apply because no rejection has been issued
S10.2 escalating now would be premature and is an error despite the merits
